name: enable_tools
description: List or activate tools not loaded by default. 'list' shows unloaded tools plus group shortcuts; 'enable' takes tool names or a group name, expanding to that group's members ('builtin' is only an enable-ability flag and never expands). Enabled tools become available in subsequent calls — knowledge, skills, process/IPC primitives, MCP servers, and the lazy subagent orchestration family.

operation.description: list: show unloaded available tools plus group shortcuts; enable: activate tools or a whole group for subsequent calls.

tools.description: Tool names to enable, or group names (expanded to their members). Required for 'enable'.
